result.OAMSM_FOLLOWER: Enable the follower on whichever OAMS is loaded on a lane
result.OAMSM_LOAD_FILAMENT: Load a spool from a group (lane inferred from group), optionally a specific UI API v1 SLOT within it
result.OAMSM_STAGE: Report a toolchange/unload plan and its progress (never fails)
result.OAMSM_UNLOAD_FILAMENT: Unload the spool loaded on a lane
result.OAMSM_VALIDATE_LOAD: Validate a UI load target without moving filament
result.OAMS_LOAD_SPOOL: Load a specific bay on this OAMS
result.OAMS_UNLOAD_SPOOL: Unload the spool loaded on this OAMS
result.RESPOND: Echo the message prepended with a prefix
result.RESTORE_GCODE_STATE: Restore a previously saved G-Code state
result.SET_GCODE_VARIABLE: Set the value of a G-Code macro variable
result.TEMPERATURE_WAIT: Wait for a temperature on a sensor
